support_policy: 10.1.0 candidate. Existing 7.0+ tunnels keep API v1 compatibility. Native remote sign-in handoff and current-device rename require Server 10.1.0 and the frozen additive API 1.5.0 contract. Remote-control payloads use authenticated end-to-end DTLS UDP, preferring direct P2P with optional server UDP TURN and no TCP fallback. Formal publication requires a frozen API contract and reviewed acceptance receipts bound to these exact candidate packages. The release notes identify verified and unverified coverage. FRP keeps its independent upstream version.
tested_combination_scope: historical 10.0.0 candidate only; 10.1.0 final-artifact acceptance pending
